evidence.title: GitHub - alibey-10/indie-ui: Collection of UI components

name: Indie UI
summary: Free collection of styled React components with Framer Motion animations, built on Tailwind and shadcn.
description: Copy-paste React components styled with Tailwind CSS and animated with Framer Motion: buttons (simple, eye-catching, stateful), inputs, several card layouts, bento grids, skeleton and text loaders, text animations, a counter, header and separator. Dark mode support and TypeScript; docs with code snippets at ui.indie-starter.dev.
contains: buttons, inputs, cards, bento grids, loaders, text animations, counter, header and separator
built with React, shadcn and Framer Motion
dark mode support out of the box, TypeScript
docs with live demos, props and get-code snippets
header component with wide and centered variants and a sticky option
